article_title: 从生成代码到可信代码：微软开源单测 agent
core_theme: 微软开源 code-testing-generator：一个 polyglot 单元测试生成 agent，用「学习仓库→规划→写作→验证」四步工作流把一行模糊 prompt 变成可信、可运行、可被 CI 发现的测试
reader_takeaway: 装好插件后，一行 Generate unit tests 也能产出通过构建、断言有效、仓库测试命令能发现的测试；基准显示完成率 92.1% 对 78.9%
summary_angle: 一行模糊 prompt 进入四步「信任工坊」，产出经过验证的可信测试；同样的模型和工作量，可靠性大幅领先

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文工作流第一步：agent 先搜索仓库、检测语言与测试框架、学习现有测试约定
information_blocks.visual_idea: 工坊入口处一份展开的仓库蓝图/代码页，代表先学习仓库

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文四步工作流：学习仓库→确定工作量→计划并写测试→检查测试有用性
information_blocks.visual_idea: 一台精致的加工装置把一条流水线分四段处理，代表四步工作流

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文基准：内部 152 任务中 agent 完成 140（92.1%），stock Copilot 120（78.9%），失败减少 63%
information_blocks.visual_idea: 流水线末端一枚带对勾的完成徽章，旁边标注完成率

main_metaphor: 一行模糊 prompt 像未加工的材料，进入一台精致的「信任工坊」，经过学习、规划、写作、验证四道工序，变成盖过检验章的可信测试
primary_subject: 一台精致的信任工坊装置（中央加工枢纽）
subject_action: 把一条输入流经过四段工序处理后，输出一份带检验章的测试成品
composition: 居中主物体 + 少量辅助符号

final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: 微软开源单测生成 agent 的四步工作流把一行模糊 prompt 变成可信测试。The reader should quickly feel: 一行 Generate unit tests 也能产出经过验证、可靠可信的测试。Summary angle: 一行模糊 prompt 进入四步「信任工坊」，产出带检验章的可信测试，完成率 92.1%。Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 3 supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: (1) step 学习: 工坊入口处一份展开的仓库代码蓝图，代表 agent 先学习仓库约定; (2) mechanism 规划: 一台精致加工装置把输入流分四段工序处理，代表学习-规划-写作-验证工作流; (3) evidence 验证: 流水线末端一枚带对勾的检验徽章，标注 92.1% 完成率。Main metaphor: 一行模糊 prompt 像未加工的材料，进入一台精致的「信任工坊」，经过四道工序后变成盖过检验章的可信测试。Subject: 一台精致的信任工坊装置（中央加工枢纽），把一条输入流经过四段工序处理后输出带检验章的测试成品。Composition/framing: 居中主物体加少量辅助符号，宽幅下保持可读。Style/medium: combine product-poster style illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: ornate fantasy fashion illustration, lace-like detail, dollhouse elegance, soft magical palette, controlled decorative density. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: 藕荷紫、奶油白、金色。Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary, all sourced from the information blocks: 学习, 规划, 验证, 92.1%. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: 代码雨、漂浮芯片、真实 dashboard、假终端输出、英文长标签、赛博朋克紫蓝光污染。Wide cover illustration, aspect ratio 2.35:1.
